expectations.text: KRBTGT account credential changes now at least every six months (ISM-1847, was annual)
DCSync-permission account reviews now at least every six months (ISM-1934, was annual)
Post-deployment vulnerability assessments/penetration tests now at least every six months (ISM-2118, was annual)
expectations.evidence: "Post-deployment vulnerability assessments and penetration tests (ISM-2118): annual → 6-monthly"

expectations.text: Service provider access restricted to explicitly approved remote management tools, source addresses and time windows (ISM-2124), with organisation-controlled logging the provider cannot modify or delete (ISM-2125)
expectations.evidence: "approved remote-management tools, specific source IP ranges/addresses, and specific time windows (ISM-2124)" and "logging of MSP activity must be under your organisation's control... which the provider could alter or fail to retain" (ISM-2125)

expectations.text: Unauthorised service-provider access or administration is to be treated as a cyber security incident (ISM-1576 amendment)
expectations.evidence: "ISM-1576 amended — unauthorised provider access is now explicitly a cyber security incident"
